about: Lists of local providers for Brigham City, Utah and Box Elder County (Perry, Willard, Tremonton), found 6 October 2026 under brief-lists-only-20261006. Lists only: no provider names recorded as resources, no office-fit rules, no provider pages checked. Statewide Utah lists (211 Utah DHHS directory pages, Utah Legal Services, DLD, vitalrecords, jobs.utah.gov fee waiver, Commerce telecom assistance, veterans.utah.gov, mihp maternal guide, utcourts legal clinics, Lifeline) are already in ogden.json (statewide, see ogden.json) and are not repeated here. Ogden and Weber County lists in ogden.json also serve Brigham City (Ogden is about 20 minutes away, Michael, 6 October 2026) and are not repeated; see that file's URLs, notably the 211 Weber-Morgan Resource List 2024-2025 (https://211utah.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Weber-Morgan-Resource-List-2024-2025.pdf), Ogden City and Weber County pages, and the Weber-Morgan Health Department flyers. Bear River regional lists that cover Box Elder as well as Cache are in logan.json and listed again here: the Bear River Health Department mental health directory (2021 and 2020 copies), the MIHP Bear River substance use cards and guide, BRAG pages, Bear River Area Agency on Aging, the Church ICP food list. Logan-only lists (Cache County 211 list, USU, Bridgerland Tech, CAPSA and the Cache aggregators) are not included. Not read: two Box Elder School District pages (bot challenge), the 'Need Food Help - Box Elder County' flyer (host did not resolve), NeedHelpPayingBills and Homeless Shelter Directory (refused).

gaps.addiction: Fair, mostly regional. Local entries are the Bear River Health Department and Bear River Mental Health, from the 2025 MIHP cards and a 2021 directory; county directory has 4 (AA, NA, BRHD). 211's detox entries are in Ogden and Salt Lake. No Brigham City or Tremonton meeting list found (AA is by Cache Valley number); Ogden's Weber-Morgan list (ogden.json) is the nearest fuller one.
gaps.children-pregnancy: Fair. 211 2025 list and the county directory name the Family Support Center (crisis nursery), Head Start, Boys and Girls Club, Pregnancy Care Center. Nothing for diapers, baby gear or teens; pregnancy block includes Logan entries. Ogden's maternal guide and health department flyer (ogden.json) are an alternative.
gaps.clothing-household: Thin. Only 3 entries on 211 (Deseret Industries, Fuller Center, a Logan thrift store). No Box Elder clothing or furniture list; relies on Ogden's (ogden.json), which is also thin.
gaps.disability: Thin. 211's block of about 11 is half Logan or statewide; the county directory has 2. No Box Elder disability list of its own.
gaps.domestic-violence: Fair for a small county, the same few providers everywhere (New Hope Crisis Center, CAPSA in Logan, statewide lines). Ogden/Weber victim lists (ogden.json) add little local to Box Elder.
gaps.education: Thin. Only a handful of entries (USU Brigham City, Job Corps, Head Start). Adult education and ESL at Sunrise High School/Box Elder Adult Education found only through search, not on a list. Statewide adult education directory is in ogden.json.
gaps.employment: Thin. 211 block of 7, the BRAG STEPS contact, DWS (Logan number on 211). No Brigham City or Tremonton job-seeker list; Ogden's lists (ogden.json) are the fallback.
gaps.financial-assistance: Fair but statewide. 211 gives about 13 entries, mostly statewide or phone-only; BRAG lists benefit navigator and VITA. The county aggregator page was blocked (403).
gaps.reentry-support: None of its own. No Box Elder reentry list found: the 211 and county directory pages have none, and the sheriff's pages describe visitation only. Relies on the statewide and Ogden/Weber reentry lists in ogden.json (Weber sheriff's reentry page, Northern Utah Community Correctional Center) and the Church felon-resources page.
gaps.food: Good. 211 2025 list (8), county directory (3), Plentiful (3), Feeding America (5, duplicates), Church ICP, plus a 'Need Food Help' Box Elder flyer from a host that did not resolve. All name the same few providers: Box Elder Community Pantry, Tremonton pantry, Acts Six soup kitchen, mobile pantry, senior centers.
gaps.medical-dental-vision: Fair. 211 block of 10, FreeClinics.us (3). Dental and vision low-cost lists not found; Ogden's clinic lists (ogden.json) cover Midtown CHC and others.
gaps.homeless-services: None in the county. Every list (211's 6 entries, county directory's 2) sends people to Ogden: Lantern House, Rescue Mission, Family Promise, Youth Futures. BRAG's START office in Brigham City and the Bear River Local Homeless Council exist but name no partners. Relies on Ogden's lists (ogden.json) and the Weber County homeless council page.
gaps.housing: Fair. 211 housing block, county directory (BRAG, Habitat), Affordable Housing Hub (11 properties), BRAG pages. No local list of landlords, rent help or waitlists beyond those aggregators; Ogden's (ogden.json) offers more.
gaps.id-recovery: None of its own. Only Brigham City DMV and Driver License Division numbers on 211. Birth certificate help, ID fee waivers and Social Security cards rely on the statewide and Ogden lists (ogden.json: DWS fee waivers, vitalrecords homeless providers, DLD offices).
gaps.immigration: None of its own. 211's ethnic support block is 4 Salt Lake organisations; the county directory has Centro de la Familia under education. Cache Refugee and Immigrant Center (serves Box Elder) found by search only. Relies on Ogden/Weber and statewide lists (ogden.json).
gaps.legal: Fair, statewide. 211 (8) and the county directory (6) list Utah Legal Services, Disability Law Center, courts self help, Timpanogos Legal Center. No Brigham City legal clinic list; statewide clinic list in ogden.json.
gaps.mental-health: Good for crisis and public services (Bear River Mental Health in Brigham City and Tremonton, the Bear River directory, 211, county directory), thin for private counselors; the Bear River directory is from 2020-21.
gaps.seniors: Fair. 211 (about 5), county directory (3), BRAG and Area Agency on Aging pages. Names both senior centers; no list of in-home services.
gaps.transportation: Thin. 211 has 4 entries (BRAG medical vouchers, Logisticare, veterans van); no local bus or taxi list. UTA coordinated mobility page in ogden.json covers Box Elder County among others (not re-read).
gaps.utilities-phone-internet: Fair, statewide. 211 housing/utilities block (HEAT, weatherization, power and gas companies, Lifeline) and the BRAG HEAT contact. Commerce Department and Lifeline pages are in ogden.json.
gaps.veterans: None of its own. 211 names only the Ogden VA clinic and the veterans van; the county directory has no veterans category. A Box Elder veterans service officer (Brigham City) shows on one aggregator whose record is no longer maintained. Relies on BRAG's page and statewide lists (veterans.utah.gov in ogden.json).
